_comment: Guild Week and world events (#46, GDD 6.5, professions.md section 3). 'demand' multiplies NPC demand per hour for an item; 'price' sets where an item's price drifts toward (x its usual value) while active. Weekdays are UTC (1 = Monday ... 7 = Sunday). Events are announced on the news board before they start. Every number is [tune].

week.name: Restock Monday
week.headline: Prospectors flood the market: raw materials are cheap today.

week.name: Regatta announced
week.headline: The Portovela Regatta is announced for Friday! Crews and their guards are stocking up.

week.name: Regatta eve
week.headline: Tomorrow is Regatta Day. Swords, jerkins and tonics are in demand.

week.name: Regatta Day
week.headline: Regatta Day! Crews pay top price for gear and draughts.

week.name: Quiet Saturday
week.headline: The harbor rests after the Regatta. Prices settle.

week.name: Market Day
week.headline: Market Day: townsfolk are out shopping, and collectors are in town.

list.name: Mine collapse
list.headline: A shaft collapsed in the Old Copper Works. Ore will be scarce.

list.name: Dock fever
list.headline: A fever is spreading through the docks. Healing Draughts are needed.

list.name: The Doge's commission
list.headline: The Doge is fitting out a war galley: swords and jerkins wanted.

list.name: The Libeccio
list.headline: A storm is blowing in from the sea. Everyone wants lanterns.

list.name: Tannery fire
list.headline: Fire at the Harbor Tannery! Leather goods will be short.

list.name: Bumper harvest
list.headline: A bumper harvest on the hill farms: herbs are flooding in.

list.name: A galley from the Levant
list.headline: A galley from the Levant has docked! Its shipwrights want fittings and tonics.
